entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
No. 12.03.2025  01.
 1.
The petitioner is the accused in the F.I.R. in connection with Jaleswar P.S. Case No.28 of 2024 corresponding to Special Case No.13 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 363/
376(2)(n)/ 376(8)/34 of the IPC r/w Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Special Court, POCSO, Balasore.
2. The investigation in the present case is still going on.
At this stage, the petitioner has filed the present petition seeking quashing of the entire F.I.R. on the ground that the victim girl has already been recovered.
The ground on the basis of which the present petition is filed is not sustainable because the investigation in the present case is still going on.
3. Therefore, I am not inclined to entertain the present petition at this stage.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to approach this Court at the appropriate stage, if the cause of action survives then.
4. With the aforementioned observation, the CRLMC is disposed of.

(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Designation: Personal Assistant Location: High Court of Orissa,
Cuttack.
